resources.string: Paste the link from Emdash → Settings → Remote access on your computer, or type the computer\'s address and the access key set there. A copied link fills in by itself.
Not an Emdash link or a computer\'s address.
Check that Emdash is running on it and that this phone is on the same network (EasyTier, Tailscale, Wi-Fi). It keeps trying while this app is open.
This phone was signed out of it. Paste its new link from Settings → Remote access, or enter the access key.
Remove %1$s from this phone? You\'ll need its link again to reconnect.
Tap a computer to open it. Long-press to rename, reload or remove it.
Enter the access key to sign in with an address.
Too many tries. Try again in %1$d min.
This computer has no access key: paste its link instead.
